! JO9 MOD START UI_TRAIT_OVERVIEW_20261025 ! Read-only profile view. Existing builders supply the already-rendered list. if $args[0] = 'escape': $result = $replace($args[1], '&', '&') $result = $replace($result, '<', '<') $result = $replace($result, '>', '>') $result = $replace($result, '"', '"') $result = $replace($result, "'", ''') exit end if $args[0] = 'meta': local $j9_action = $func('jo9_traits_view', 'escape', $args[2]) local $j9_desc = $func('jo9_traits_view', 'escape', $args[3]) $result = '' exit end if $args[0] = 'remember': local $j9_html = $maintxt local $j9_role = $strfind($j9_html, 'id="jo9_tv_root" data-role="(slave|assistant)" data-open="1"', 1) if $j9_role ! '': local $j9_name = $dyneval('$result = $' + $j9_role + '_name') $jo9_tv_reopen_key = $j9_role + ':' + $j9_name end exit end if $args[0] = 'sidebar': local $j9_role = $args[1] if $j9_role ! 'slave' and $j9_role ! 'assistant': exit local $j9_raw = $args[2] local $j9_title = '노예의 특성' if $j9_role = 'assistant': $j9_title = '조수의 특성' local $j9_open = '0' local $j9_name = $dyneval('$result = $' + $j9_role + '_name') if $jo9_tv_reopen_key = $j9_role + ':' + $j9_name: $j9_open = '1' $jo9_tv_reopen_key = '' local $j9_meta = $func('jo9_traits_view', 'meta', 0, '__return__', $info_text) local $j9_scan = $j9_raw local $j9_pattern = '(?i)href\s*=\s*"([^"]*)"' local $j9_match = $strfind($j9_scan, $j9_pattern) local j9_index = 0 local $j9_href, $j9_action, $j9_expr, $j9_key, $j9_desc local j9_at :j9_tv_scan if $j9_match ! '': $j9_href = $strfind($j9_scan, $j9_pattern, 1) $j9_action = '' $j9_desc = '' if $lcase($mid($j9_href, 1, 5)) = 'exec:': $j9_action = $trim($mid($j9_href, 6)) $j9_expr = $strfind($j9_action, '(?i)^\s*msg\s+(\$[A-Za-z_А-Яа-яЁё가-힣][A-Za-z_А-Яа-яЁё가-힣0-9]*)\s*$', 1) if $j9_expr !
